Your request reached the transport office.'; Admin login (admin/RoutYAdmin2026Secure) -> Control room shows 'Route requests' stat tile; /admin/suggestions lists prior submissions with New/Reviewed/Rejected status buttons and Approved badge. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). No React Native red screen. Only console noise: legacy shadow*/pointerEvents warnings (framework-level) and one dev-only 'GO_BACK not handled' warning when /suggest is opened via deep-link.

ui_bugs.issue: After Send request success, code calls router.back() which throws 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' when the page was opened via deep-link/direct URL (no navigation history). The success toast still shows but the user is stranded on the form. Suggest using router.replace('/settings') or router.canGoBack() guard.

action_items: Confirm my 1-line backend fix in server.py: reordered /api/stops/nearest to be declared BEFORE /api/stops/{stop_id} — otherwise FastAPI matched 'nearest' as the {stop_id} path param and returned 404 (Map tab's Use-my-location -> nearest stop was broken). See rca_of_issue.
Optional: in /app/frontend/app/suggest.tsx replace router.back() after submit with router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/settings') to avoid GO_BACK warning on deep-link opens.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering matters in FastAPI: dynamic path params like /stops/{stop_id} must always come AFTER any literal sibling routes like /stops/nearest. This was the sole regression introduced in iter-2.
server.py excludes MongoDB _id in all reads (verified) and uses env vars for all URLs/creds.
OSRM fallback path in POST /api/admin/routes is correct — sets path_source='straight' if osrm_snap raises, which is desirable when the free OSRM server is briefly unreachable.
Frontend api.ts consistently uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; no hardcoded URLs found.

testIDs present on tab bar and key interactive elements. Suggest form fields are accessible by placeholder text; adding testIDs (from-input, to-input, submit-request) would make automated testing more robust.

rca_of_issue: BUG: GET /api/stops/nearest?lat=..&lng=.. returned 404 'Stop not found' after iter-2 changes. ROOT CAUSE: server.py declared @api.get('/stops/{stop_id}') at line 183 BEFORE @api.get('/stops/nearest') at line 211. FastAPI matches routes in declaration order, so the literal path 'nearest' was captured as the {stop_id} path parameter, and engine.stop_arrivals('nearest') returned None -> HTTPException 404. This broke the Map tab's 'Use my location -> nearest stop' feature. REPRO: curl 'https://<host>/api/stops/nearest?lat=26.93&lng=81.19' -> 404 before fix. FIX: moved the /stops/nearest handler above /stops/{stop_id} in server.py; restarted supervisor 'backend'. Verified curl now returns the Barabanki Bus Stand doc with route metadata. All 31 pytest cases pass post-fix. This is the only backend regression from iter-2.
